name: Conversion engine
outcome: Docker becomes buildah and S2I becomes source-to-image. Git, binary, image and inline-Dockerfile sources convert. The plugin whiteouts the BuildConfig and emits the Build over the crane plugin protocol, offline.

name: Image references and registries
outcome: ImageStream references resolve through the two mapping flags, with a warned fallback to the internal registry URL. Search, insecure and block registry lists pass through. Output can be redirected off the internal registry.

name: Buildah option parity
outcome: noCache, forcePull, squash, the runtime-stage image and buildArgs (including ConfigMap and Secret references) survive migration as strategy params the shipped buildah strategy declares.

name: S2I option parity
outcome: The builder image survives. Custom scripts, incremental builds and forcePull have params in the shipped strategy, but the plugin still drops them with an RFE warning.
status_text: gap: operator done, plugin not ported

name: Credentials, ServiceAccounts and volumes
outcome: A pull secret lands on a generated ServiceAccount, a named account is never overwritten, and a missing push credential is named in a warning. Secret and ConfigMap volumes carry over with an exact strategy fix. Source secrets and ConfigMaps get a runbook instead of a half migration.
status_text: partly: trusted CA and SA+RBAC open

name: BuildConfig field coverage
outcome: Labels, annotations, completion deadline, nodeSelector, history limits, image labels and resources (as a BuildRun template) are mapped, not dropped.

name: Conversion outcome and warnings
outcome: Each BuildConfig ends in one of four recorded outcomes. A lossy conversion never looks clean, one bad BuildConfig never aborts the run, and 62 warnings are catalogued.

name: Triggers
outcome: Trigger configuration is preserved as an annotation and warned per type. No trigger type fires after migration today. The re-trigger runbook is not written.

name: Safe migration runs
outcome: Converting twice gives byte-identical output. Generated names are valid DNS labels with a hash suffix and collision handling. A dry-run flag is unnecessary because the transform step never touches a cluster.

name: Test infrastructure and CI
outcome: Unit tests with a coverage gate, a transform E2E script and a Minikube cluster E2E run in CI. A YAML-rules E2E framework with 18 real BuildConfigs is in review.
status_text: in CI; framework in review; no Jira stories

name: Documentation and examples
outcome: Architecture page, support matrix, three worked examples, README rewrite and eight decision records are open PRs. The volume runbook is on main. The docs pack, trigger runbook, crane help and blog are not started.

name: Engineering workflow
outcome: Agent skills carry a story from design through implementation, review, test and PR. Process chores from the audit were closed without work.

name: Strategy parameter contract
outcome: The param names the plugin emits match the shipped ClusterBuildStrategies. The params landed through strategy-catalog and the operator sync. The automated drift guard was descoped, so cluster E2E and review are the only check.

name: Upstream API and dependency alignment
outcome: The Shipwright omitempty API change shipped upstream and the plugin pins Shipwright v0.20.11 and a crane-lib pseudo-version. crane consuming omitempty waits on Shipwright v0.21.

name: Destination pre-flight checks
outcome: Verify Shipwright, Tekton, the strategies and RBAC on the target before apply. Descoped because the plugin is offline by design.
